status: SAMPLE: every page below was read on the funder's own site on 17 Oct 2026. Read each one again and confirm each date by hand before sending.
intro: Seven calls to watch and three on the watchlist. Each one links to the funder's own page, and we say "not stated" where a page does not say.

listings.amount: Equity investment up to $2.5 million; grants up to $500,000
listings.deadline: 1pm Monday 9 November 2026 (next on the page: 1pm Tuesday 9 February 2027)
listings.who: The applicant must be an experienced New Zealand producer and the lead producer must be a New Zealand citizen or permanent resident. Significant New Zealand content, and the project must be production-ready with a confirmed schedule and viable finance plan. Documentary features: not stated.
listings.state: Read on the funder's page by Claude. Not yet confirmed by hand.

listings.amount: Not stated (a pitching showcase, 12 to 14 April 2027)
listings.deadline: Final deadline 15 December 2026. The early deadline (2 November 2026) has passed.
listings.who: Feature-length projects over 60 minutes from anywhere in the world, in late development and not yet in production. The fee is CHF 40 since 3 November.
listings.state: Read on the funder's page by Claude. Not yet confirmed by hand.

listings.deadline: No deadline. Channel 4's briefs page says its commissioning teams accept pitches on a rolling, ongoing basis.
listings.who: Submissions are welcome from PACT-registered companies with relevant experience. Email top lines to the relevant Commissioning Editor first.
listings.state: Read on the funder's page by Claude. Not yet confirmed by hand.

listings.deadline: Opens 1pm Monday 9 November 2026. Closes 1pm Monday 21 December 2026.
listings.who: Independent non-fiction films by UK filmmakers. Producers apply, for experienced or debut producers and directors.
listings.state: Read on the funder's page by Claude. Not yet confirmed by hand.
listings.note: Apply to the Diversity Standards first: https://ds.bfi.org.uk/entrant/dashboard.php. Read the funding guidelines in full before applying online.

listings.region: US-based producers, or producers who work and reside in Europe or Latin America
listings.deadline: Opens 9am PT Tuesday 17 November 2026. Closes 9am PT Wednesday 10 February 2027.
listings.who: Lead producers who are not the director, have produced at least one documentary short and no more than two features as lead producer, and are in active production or post-production. US-based producers are eligible; non-US candidates must work and reside in Europe or Latin America.
listings.state: Read on the funder's page by Claude. Not yet confirmed by hand.
listings.note: The page calls the application open, but its FAQ and guidelines say "All applicants are considered by invitation only." Ask docproducers@sundance.org how invitations work before you apply. Application fee: not stated.

listings.deadline: Entries open 15 November (year not stated). Deadline 15 January 2027.
listings.who: The European co-producer enters the project as a minority producer. It needs a MEDIA Sub-programme co-producer with at least a 20% share (combined shares of other MEDIA-country co-producers cannot exceed 70%), a director from an IBF Europe Country List country, and a total project budget up to 600,000 euros.
listings.state: Read on the funder's page by Claude. Not yet confirmed by hand.
listings.note: The 2027 rules now apply to this call. Projects must reach rough cut at the time of application.

listings.amount: A share of the budget: up to 80% capped at $300,000 for Direct-to-Audience, up to 20% capped at $500,000 for Platform First and Producer First. Refer to the guidelines.
listings.deadline: 5pm AEDT Thursday 4 February 2027. Next round: 5pm AEST Thursday 8 April 2027.
listings.who: Australian production companies (and in some cases individuals). Needs Significant Australian Content or official co-production status. Writer and director must be Australian citizens or permanent residents, apart from official co-productions.
listings.state: Read on the funder's page by Claude. Not yet confirmed by hand.

listings.amount: $25,000 to each of three projects (one chosen per round), plus a free one-year IDA Doc Maker Membership
listings.deadline: Nominations for the first 2026-27 round closed at the end of October; nominated projects submit a short application in early December; the grantee is chosen in mid-January. Later rounds: February and May 2027.
listings.who: Projects are chosen from nominations by film organizations in the United States (Catapult Film Fund is the only nominator named for 2026), not open applications. Applicants can be based anywhere. Film budget up to $700,000, in late post-production with a rough cut, on the 2026 theme of US influence. At least one director or producer needs a completed nonfiction feature of 40 minutes or longer.
listings.state: Read on the funder's page by Claude. Not yet confirmed by hand.

listings.amount: Up to $400k for long-form features, up to $50k for stand-alone shorts
listings.deadline: Not currently accepting applications. No dates given.

listings.who: Independent feature-length documentaries (52 minutes and longer). A fiscal sponsor is not required. No country limit is stated.
